## Architecture Overview

The `Matches` method on `labels.Selector` interface in `k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/labels` has signature `Matches(Labels) bool`. Adding a `context.Context` parameter changes it to `Matches(ctx context.Context, Labels) bool`, breaking all callers.

## Detailed Analysis

### Helm

- **`pkg/action/list.go`** (lines 289-299) — `selector.Matches(labels.Set(rls.Labels))` in `filterSelector()` filtering Helm releases by label selector.
- **`pkg/kube/wait.go`** (lines 157-207) — `labels.SelectorFromSet()` and `metav1.LabelSelectorAsSelector()` in `SelectorsForObject()` for pod readiness checking.

### ArgoCD

- **`server/application/application.go`** (lines 1205, 2019, 2806) — `selector.Matches(labels.Set(a.Labels))` filtering applications, `proj.Spec.SyncWindows.Matches(a)` for sync windows.
- **`controller/appcontroller.go`** (line 1850) — `project.Spec.SyncWindows.Matches(app).CanSync(false)` for sync eligibility.
- **`controller/sync.go`** (line 560) — `proj.Spec.SyncWindows.Matches(app)` for sync prevention.
- **`applicationset/utils/selector.go`** (lines 29-262) — Custom `Selector` interface with `Matches(labels.Labels) bool`.
- **`cmd/argocd/commands/app.go`** — CLI application filtering by labels.

### External-DNS

- **`source/source.go`** (lines 55-65) — `selector.Matches(labels.Set(srcAnnotations))` in `matchLabelSelector()`.
- **`source/annotations/filter.go`** (lines 30-50) — `selector.Matches(labels.Set(item.GetAnnotations()))` generic annotation filter.
- **`source/gateway.go`** (lines 263, 524) — Route annotation and namespace label filtering.
- **`source/informers/indexers.go`** (lines 85, 89) — Cache indexer annotation and label selector matching.

### Ingress-Nginx

- **`internal/ingress/controller/store/store.go`** (line 381) — `namespaceSelector.Matches(labels.Set(ns.Labels))` for namespace filtering.
